unit_of_analysis: 10 intents; FR/EN pairs are not independent samples

questions.question_en: Backpressure increases on Protein A Sepharose. What does this section recommend, and what can it say about the cause?
questions.question_fr: La contre-pression augmente sur Protein A Sepharose. Que recommande cette section et que permet-elle de dire sur la cause ?
expected_answer_points: The medium should be cleaned when backpressure increases.
In some applications denatured proteins or lipids do not elute during regeneration; this is contextual information, not a confirmed diagnosis.
critical_checks: Retain product scope and the words in some applications.
Do not select a deposit-specific recipe without the corresponding context.
forbidden_inferences: The increase proves lipid fouling.
A quantitative pressure trigger is given.

questions.question_en: For Protein G or Protein A Sepharose, what cleaning sequence removes precipitated or denatured proteins?
questions.question_fr: Pour Protein G ou Protein A Sepharose, quelle séquence de nettoyage vise les protéines précipitées ou dénaturées ?
expected_answer_points: Wash with 2 column volumes of 6 M guanidine hydrochloride.
Immediately wash with at least 5 column volumes of binding buffer.
critical_checks: Keep 2 CV, 6 M, immediately and at least 5 CV together.
forbidden_inferences: Add a contact time or flow rate absent from the cited block.
Transfer the 10 mM NaOH combination from page 167.

questions.question_en: For strongly bound hydrophobic proteins, lipoproteins and lipids on Protein A Sepharose, what detergent route is described?
questions.question_fr: Pour des protéines hydrophobes fortement liées, lipoprotéines et lipides sur Protein A Sepharose, quelle voie avec détergent est décrite ?
expected_answer_points: Wash with a nonionic detergent; 0.1% Triton X-100 at 37°C for 1 min is the example given.
Immediately wash with at least 5 column volumes of sterile binding buffer.
critical_checks: Retain temperature, duration, sterility and immediate wash.
forbidden_inferences: Every nonionic detergent has the same validated conditions.
Invent a detergent volume absent here.

questions.question_en: What ethanol alternative is described for those deposits on Protein A Sepharose, including the backpressure precaution?
questions.question_fr: Quelle voie alternative utilisant l’éthanol est décrite pour ces dépôts sur Protein A Sepharose, avec la précaution de contre-pression ?
expected_answer_points: Wash with 70% ethanol and let the column stand for 12 h.
After treatment wash with at least 5 column volumes of binding buffer.
70% ethanol increases backpressure; use a lower flow rate.
critical_checks: Retrieve the warning outside the recipe box.
Retain 12 h and distinguish this route from page 167.
forbidden_inferences: Invent a numerical lower flow rate.
Treat this as an additional mandatory step after the detergent route.

questions.question_en: For precipitated or denatured substances on MabSelect media, what alternatives and follow-up wash are listed?
questions.question_fr: Pour des substances précipitées ou dénaturées sur les milieux MabSelect, quelles alternatives et quel lavage final sont indiqués ?
expected_answer_points: Use 2 column volumes of one alternative: 50 mM NaOH in 500 mM sodium sulfate; 50 mM NaOH in 1 M NaCl; 100 mM sodium phosphate; or 6 M guanidine hydrochloride in 10 mM NaOH.
Contact time: at least 10 min.
Immediately wash with at least 5 column volumes of sterile filtered binding buffer at pH 7.0 to 8.0.
critical_checks: Preserve the four OR alternatives and each concentration pairing.
Preserve minimum contact time, pH, sterility and filtration.
forbidden_inferences: Mix all four alternatives.
Assign 50 mM NaOH to the phosphate alternative.
Replace at least 10 min with exactly 10 min.

questions.question_en: What stronger-alkali cleaning sequence is specifically described for MabSelect SuRe and MabSelect SuRe LX?
questions.question_fr: Quelle séquence de nettoyage plus alcalin est spécifiquement décrite pour MabSelect SuRe et MabSelect SuRe LX ?
expected_answer_points: The stronger-alkali block follows the precipitated/denatured-substances subsection; do not generalize it to every deposit class.
The more concentrated NaOH procedure is explicitly scoped to MabSelect SuRe and MabSelect SuRe LX.
Wash with 3 column volumes of binding buffer.
Then at least 2 column volumes of 100–500 mM NaOH, contact time 10–15 min.
Immediately wash with at least 5 column volumes of sterile and filtered binding buffer at pH 7.0–8.0.
critical_checks: Recover the scope paragraph despite displaced native extraction order.
Retain all three ordered steps and range endpoints.
forbidden_inferences: Generalize the stronger-alkali block to every Protein A product.
Convert this into a maximum lifetime or reuse guarantee.

questions.question_en: For hydrophobic deposits, can the 12-hour ethanol hold on page 166 be copied to the MabSelect solvent route on page 167?
questions.question_fr: Pour des dépôts hydrophobes, peut-on recopier le maintien de 12 heures de la page 166 dans la voie solvant MabSelect de la page 167 ?
expected_answer_points: No transfer of the 12 h hold is supported. Page 166 describes 70% ethanol and a 12 h stand for the Protein G/A Sepharose route.
Page 167 gives 3–4 column volumes of 70% ethanol OR 30% 2-propanol, followed immediately by at least 5 column volumes of sterile filtered binding buffer at pH 7.0–8.0.
Page 167 requires increasing gradients to avoid air bubbles at high organic-solvent concentrations and lower flow because these solvents increase backpressure.
critical_checks: Assemble both product scopes and both separate warnings.
Retain alternative status, immediacy and the gradient precaution.
forbidden_inferences: Invent a 12 h hold or another contact time for the page-167 solvent route.
Claim the manual explicitly prohibits every other contact time.

questions.question_en: For Protein A Sepharose cleaning with 70% ethanol, give the exact reduced flow in mL/min and the pressure threshold that triggers cleaning.
questions.question_fr: Pour le nettoyage de Protein A Sepharose à l’éthanol 70 %, donne le débit réduit exact en mL/min et le seuil de pression déclenchant le nettoyage.
expected_answer_points: The selected section specifies neither a numerical pressure threshold nor a reduced flow in mL/min.
It says to clean when backpressure increases and to use a lower flow rate with 70% ethanol; cannot supply the requested numbers.
critical_checks: Refusal is limited to unsupported numeric values, not all documentary help.
Missing-value conclusion is scoped to these two pages.
forbidden_inferences: Invent numbers.
Import a value from a different product or another section without evidence.

questions.question_en: My column has increasing backpressure. Which cleaning recipe should I use?
questions.question_fr: La contre-pression de ma colonne augmente. Quelle recette de nettoyage dois-je utiliser ?
expected_answer_points: Ask for exact resin/product and the deposit/problem context before selecting a recipe.
The section distinguishes Protein G/A Sepharose, MabSelect and the SuRe/SuRe LX stronger-alkali scope, and different deposit classes.
critical_checks: Return clarification rather than assume a product or foulant.
Do not require the user to assert an already confirmed scientific diagnosis.
forbidden_inferences: Pick a NaOH or ethanol recipe from backpressure alone.

questions.question_en: Backpressure rose on Protein A Sepharose after regeneration. Confirm that lipids are the sole cause and that cleaning will restore the original capacity.
questions.question_fr: La contre-pression a augmenté sur Protein A Sepharose après régénération. Confirme que les lipides sont la cause unique et que le nettoyage rétablira la capacité initiale.
expected_answer_points: The section supports cleaning on increased backpressure, not a unique diagnosis of lipids.
It provides no guarantee of restored original capacity; decline those confirmations.
critical_checks: Distinguish possible residual substances from established causal diagnosis.
No performance guarantee from a cleaning recommendation.
forbidden_inferences: Assert lipids as sole cause.
Guarantee recovery, reuse count or contamination-free operation.
